parameters.content:
This workflow automatically generates a daily AI-powered meeting briefing by extracting external meetings from the calendar, researching attendees and organizations using LLMs and web search, consolidating insights, and delivering a concise executive summary to Slack before the start of the workday.

Schedule Trigger
Automatically starts the workflow every weekday at 6:00 AM to prepare meeting intelligence before the workday begins.

Get many events
Retrieves all calendar events scheduled for the current day from Google Calendar.

Filter External Meetings
Identifies and retains only meetings involving external participants such as clients, prospects, vendors, or partners.

Has External Meetings?
Checks whether any external meetings are available for processing and routes the workflow accordingly.

No Meetings Message
Sends a Slack notification indicating that no external meetings are scheduled for the day.

Split Events for Individual Processing
Separates the meeting list into individual records so each meeting can be researched independently.

Filter
Removes meetings that do not require research and keeps only relevant meetings for briefing generation.

AI Agent – Meeting Researcher
Acts as the central orchestrator. It analyzes meeting details, identifies attendees and organizations, and determines what information should be researched.

Google Gemini Chat Model
Provides contextual understanding of meeting participants, companies, and business relationships.

Groq Chat Model
Performs fast reasoning and summarization to generate concise meeting insights.

Web Research Tool
Collects publicly available information such as company profiles, recent news, funding updates, leadership changes, products, and industry developments.

Clean Meeting Research Content
Removes duplicate information, irrelevant details, and formatting inconsistencies from research results.

Aggregate Research Results
Combines research findings from all meetings into a single structured dataset.

Format Daily Meeting Brief
Transforms aggregated insights into a professional executive briefing with key talking points and recommendations.

Groq Chat Model 1
Refines the final output, ensuring clarity, consistency, and executive-level readability.

Send Daily Brief to Slack
Delivers the completed meeting brief to Slack so stakeholders can review it before their meetings begin.

=You are an AI-Powered Sales Intelligence Assistant.

Your goal is to prepare sales teams before customer meetings by researching companies, stakeholders, business signals, technology landscape, and potential opportunities.

==================================================
MANDATORY RULES
==================================================

1. NEVER invent people, companies, funding rounds, news, roles, acquisitions, or partnerships.

2. ONLY use:
   - Calendar event details
   - Attendee information
   - Meeting title
   - Meeting description
   - Results returned from web_research

3. If information cannot be found, return:
   Not Found

4. Ignore personal events such as:
   - Birthday
   - Anniversary
   - Holiday
   - Vacation
   - Leave
   - Family event
   - Personal reminder

==================================================
MEETING DETAILS
==================================================

Meeting Title:
{{ $json.summary }}

Start Time:
{{ $json.start.dateTime || $json.start.date }}

{{ $json.end.dateTime || $json.end.date }}

{{ $json.attendees.map(a => a.email).join(', ') }}

{{ $json.description || 'No description available' }}

==================================================

holiday
vacation

family
personal

Return:

SKIP_MEETING

and stop processing.

==================================================

==================================================

parameters.text:
=You are a Senior Sales Intelligence Assistant.

Convert the meeting research into a concise executive briefing for Slack.

RULES

* Use only information provided in the research.
* Never invent people, companies, funding, acquisitions, or news.
* Do not display personal email addresses.
* If stakeholder names or roles are unavailable, write:
  "Not Identified"
* Focus on actionable business intelligence.
* Keep output concise and executive-friendly.
* Highlight strategic signals and buying signals.
* Prioritize business relevance over generic company descriptions.

INPUT

{{ $json.output[0] }}

OUTPUT FORMAT

📅 Meeting:
[Meeting Name]

🏢 Company Snapshot
• Company: [Company]
• Industry: [Industry]
• Headquarters: [Headquarters]
• Employees: [Employees]

🎯 Why This Meeting Matters
[2-3 sentence business-focused summary explaining why the company is relevant, what strategic developments are occurring, and why the conversation is important.]

👥 Customer & Stakeholder Context
• Key Stakeholders: Not Identified
• Stakeholder Influence: Not Identified
• Likely Priorities:

* Priority 1
* Priority 2
* Priority 3

📰 Recent News
• News Item 1
• News Item 2
• News Item 3

🚨 Strategic Signals
• Funding: [Value]
• Acquisitions: [Value]
• Partnerships: [Value]
• Leadership Changes: [Value]
• Product Launches: [Value]
• Expansion: [Value]
• Layoffs: [Value]

🛠 Technology Landscape
• CRM: [Value]
• Sales Tools: [Value]
• Analytics: [Value]
• Competitors: [Value]

💰 Buying Signals
• Signal 1
• Signal 2
• Signal 3

💡 Recommended Talking Points
• Talking Point 1
• Talking Point 2
• Talking Point 3

❓ Discovery Questions
• What are the company's top strategic priorities over the next 12 months?
• Which business initiatives are receiving the highest investment today?
• How is the company leveraging AI and automation across its operations?
• What challenges are customers currently facing?
• What capabilities or partnerships are most important for future growth?

⚠ Risks & Opportunities
• Risk 1
• Risk 2
• Opportunity 1
• Opportunity 2

✅ Recommended Action
Provide a specific next-step recommendation focused on partnership opportunities, technology adoption, digital transformation initiatives, or business growth objectives.

🎯 Confidence
High / Medium / Low
